response_item.revised_prompt: Correct the immediately preceding EAST-facing source sheet while preserving the approved original south neutral character identity, clothing, paint texture and anatomical RIGHT-hip satchel. Two specific failures must be fixed, not hidden with assembly: the view is still nearly eye-level and the detached torso incorrectly contains an arm and a bag. Use an unmistakably elevated orthographic view looking DOWN on the character, matching the downward-looking south reference. The hood crown and shoulder tops must be visible and the figure foreshortened, with slim boots/legs. Character still faces screen RIGHT. Keep compact original proportions, no new accessory pouches, no new buckles, no giant hood/boots. Detached torso must contain ONLY the torso cloth, belt and strap, with painted shoulder joint overlap, absolutely NO head, NO arm, NO hand, NO satchel, NO coat tails. The satchel and all arms and tails are separate. Preserve the sheet arrangement: assembled east guide left, detached matching hood, clean torso, 2 upper arms, 2 forearm/gloves, 2 coat tails, 2 thighs, 2 shin-boots, and one satchel in well-separated grid right, full joint margins, common scale. Genuine transparent background with no scenery, labels, shadow, checkerboard or glow. This is a proposed source sheet, not production artwork.
